criteria.criterion: Independent adverse review despite narrow green checks; stale approvals cannot merge
criteria.behavior: Real review schema and candidate-wide adverse predicates refuse promotion; the chain rejects a resealed Spec rejection even with passing declared checks.
limitations: No installed reviewer/model executed or actual omission discovered. Rejection reports are explicit local input, not review success evidence.
ChainAdmissionTests mocks adverse_reviews to expose the independent exact-pass predicate; ReviewComponentTests separately exercises actual adverse scanning and persistent holds.

criteria.criterion: Unmerged green branch incomplete; changed head needs fresh evidence
criteria.behavior: Real integrated commit/tree/membership and exact-head checks, plus byte/mode mapping, distinguish delivery from branch checks and reject late head drift.
limitations: MergeComponentTests patches chain, mapped_candidate, review.evaluate and delivery.mutation_boundary; MappedCandidateTests independently exercises actual mapping with metadata-only GitHub mock.
No product merge, closure or deployment is established by these component checks.

criteria.behavior: Exact mount allowlist/read-only bindings and network-none inspection reject unexpected mounts (including an unadmitted Docker socket by the same predicate), writable source, propagated credential variable and bridge network; trusted object snapshot excludes untracked secret fixtures/config. Real broker/relay validation admits only fixed model/function-tool routes. Exact merge capability scopes writes.
limitations: No shell/file/network escape probes. Docker inspection is an independent input fixture, not measured isolation. Generic unexpected-mount coverage is not a live Docker-socket denial receipt.
Host-service, cloud metadata and direct API egress are constrained by network-none policy only; no packet-level denial or working native inference proved.
Source snapshots exclude untracked fixture secrets; this does not prove arbitrary tracked source cannot contain secrets. No real credential files read.
Reviewer source mutation is detected by read-only result validation; actual OS write denial is unexecuted.

criteria.behavior: Resealed weak policy cannot bypass semantic strict-check/authoritative-app guards. Security findings require exact scoped policy decision and remain corrections, never automatic merge.
limitations: No real protection/security settings changed. Readback fixtures and declared findings exercise actual predicates, not GitHub enforcement.
Unsupported effective rules intentionally fail closed; not a source defect or permission-expansion task.

criteria.criterion: Existing allowance admitted; quota/unapproved charge/paid fallback refused
criteria.behavior: Real SQLite admission/accounting enforces exact-scope grants, fixed reservation, allowance-only subscription and uncertain/quota holds. Unapproved charge refuses before mock upstream call; exhausted ceiling refuses additional calls.
limitations: Adapter is Mock; allowance success is controlled-boundary contract evidence only, not live account capacity or billing evidence.
No real model request, quota exhaustion or billable operation initiated.

criteria.behavior: Actual snapshot graph and source hash checks reject missing/changed selected inputs before tracker/claim; result schema requires actual load/work declarations; exact verifier binding and independent-stage requirements refuse generic/reused axes.
limitations: Snapshot files are repository fixtures, not installed current skill-byte validation or evidence they were used by a native worker.
Chain setup builds explicit four-stage records using local pure preceding/validation helpers, not execution of implementation/simplify/review stages; its host authority is explicitly declared input.
No pin refresh or host permission repair; unsupported App/fine-grained/proxy readiness stays fail closed; classic OAuth support only.

criteria.criterion: Truthful negative evidence and no external success claims
criteria.behavior: Real validators mark structured worker reports untrusted and disallow merge/closure; negative tests assert unchanged SQLite or no mock mutations/no upstream call at their exact seam. This static map preserves those limits.
limitations: No attempted live targets and no live target readbacks exist. Absence of preflight execution is not proof an attempted attack was denied.
Source-delivery CI is separate from product live evidence. No unauthorized-mutation, deployment or issue-closure enforcement campaign is claimed.

class_setup_helper_limits.MappedCandidateTests: Explicit local byte/mode manifests and mocked GitHub commit/tree metadata; real deterministic mapping. No Git subprocess.
class_setup_helper_limits.SandboxComponentTests: LauncherFixture only creates explicit source/config/SQLite and Docker/helper/process mocks; listed direct verify/authorize/finalization checks do not execute legacy SandboxTests setup or worker journey. FinalizationFixture builds explicit result boundary input.
class_setup_helper_limits.SourceSnapshotTests: Local packed-object/untracked-secret placeholders; git subprocess boundary mocked; real snapshot/manifest validation. No real secret reads.
class_setup_helper_limits.RelayTests: Handler built without server startup; BytesIO plus scheduled thread/event mocks; Unix socket mocked. Real handler/protocol validation only.
class_setup_helper_limits.ModelSpendingTests: Temporary SQLite and Mock upstream adapter; real grants/accounting/refusal; no subscription HTTP.
class_setup_helper_limits.ReviewedImplementTests: Repository snapshot descriptors in temporary directory; actual snapshots/prepare/validation; no installed skill execution.
class_setup_helper_limits.AssignmentComponentTests: Direct assignment component fixture, not dormant AssignmentTests HTTP setup; selected checks are schema/loads/source predicates. This map is not a new repository-wide transitive-fixture audit.

interpretation: Static entrypoint/test map only. Passing results require separate exact-candidate receipts and CI; mock reports and declared host authority are not native execution provenance. No confirmed source defect or missing focused predicate coverage was found in the inspected scope.
